title: Vocabulary and Word Meaning — Level 4 — Find the mistake

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "lend" or "borrow" correctly.

visual.text: Can you lend me your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can you lend me your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can you borrow me your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can you borrow me your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can I lend your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can I lend your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can you borrow your dictionary to me until Friday?

choices.say: Can you borrow your dictionary to me until Friday?

items.reteach: Lend = meminjamkan (memberi); borrow = meminjam (menerima). "Lend me", "borrow from you".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "The new rule will effect all students who come late."
items.reteach: "Affect" (kata kerja) = memengaruhi; "effect" (kata benda) = akibat. Seharusnya "will affect".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "My father gave me some good advise about choosing friends."
items.reteach: "Advice" (kata benda) = nasihat; "advise" (kata kerja) = menasihati. Seharusnya "good advice".

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "rise" or "raise" correctly.

visual.text: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

choices.say: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

visual.text: The sun raises in the east and sets in the west.

choices.say: The sun raises in the east and sets in the west.

visual.text: Please rise your hand before you speak.

choices.say: Please rise your hand before you speak.

visual.text: Prices have raised a lot this year.

choices.say: Prices have raised a lot this year.

items.reteach: Rise = naik sendiri (tanpa objek); raise = menaikkan sesuatu (dengan objek): raise your hand.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Be careful not to loose your ticket on the train."
items.reteach: "Lose" = kehilangan; "loose" = longgar. Seharusnya "not to lose your ticket".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "We bought some stationary, such as pens and folders, at the shop."
Choose the sentence that uses "remind" or "remember" correctly.

visual.text: Please remind me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remind me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remember me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remember me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remind me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remind me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remember to me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remember to me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

items.reteach: Remind someone to do something = mengingatkan orang lain. Remember = mengingat sendiri.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Our school principle, Mr Hadi, opened the science fair."
Find the word that is kurang tepat: "After dinner, we had fruit salad for desert."
Choose the sentence that uses "quiet" or "quite" correctly.

visual.text: The library was so quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was so quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was so quite that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was so quite that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was such quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was such quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was too quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was too quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

items.reteach: Quiet = sunyi; quite = cukup/agak. Pola: so + adjective + that.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Everyone accept Rina has handed in the science project."
Find the word that is kurang tepat: "This small car is very economic because it uses little fuel."
Choose the sentence that uses "sensitive" or "sensible" correctly.

visual.text: Babies have sensitive skin, so their parents use mild soap.

choices.say: Babies have sensitive skin, so their parents use mild soap.

visual.text: Babies have sensible skin, so their parents use mild soap.

choices.say: Babies have sensible skin, so their parents use mild soap.

visual.text: It was sensitive of you to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.

choices.say: It was sensitive of you to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.

visual.text: Wearing a helmet on a motorbike is a sensitive idea.

choices.say: Wearing a helmet on a motorbike is a sensitive idea.

items.reteach: Sensitive = peka/mudah teriritasi; sensible = masuk akal/bijak (a sensible idea).

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "The judges complemented Ayu on her excellent speech."
